quests.conceptTitle: Pre-Reading Schema Activation: Why Lighthouses Flash
quests.passage: A lighthouse doesn't shine a steady light because a constant glow could be mistaken for a house or a streetlamp on shore. Instead, each lighthouse flashes in its own pattern, such as two quick flashes every ten seconds. Sailors time the pattern with a watch and check it in a guidebook, which tells them exactly which lighthouse they are looking at.
